# Trellis

> A pure-Dart SDK for server-rendered web apps and static sites. At its core is **trellis**, a
> Thymeleaf-inspired HTML template engine: templates are valid HTML annotated with `tl:*`
> attributes, render server-side, and are fragment-first for hypermedia frameworks like HTMX.
> No Node.js, no JS build step, AOT-compatible (no reflection).

The SDK is a Melos monorepo of independently published, lockstep-versioned packages: `trellis`
(engine), `trellis_shelf` / `trellis_dart_frog` / `trellis_relic` (server integrations),
`trellis_site` (static site generation), `trellis_css` (CSS processing), `trellis_dev` (hot
reload), and `trellis_cli` (scaffolding CLI).

When generating Trellis templates, follow the agent guide first — it covers the escaping/trust
rules and the silent-failure footguns that matter most.

## For AI agents

- [Agent guide (rules for writing templates)](https://github.com/tolo/trellis/blob/main/packages/trellis/doc/trellis-for-agents.md): Escaping/trust boundary, keep-templates-dumb, core directives, silent footguns, validation. Start here.

## Core docs

- [trellis engine README](https://github.com/tolo/trellis/blob/main/packages/trellis/README.md): Full `tl:*` directive and expression syntax, configuration, loaders, validation, custom processors/dialects.
- [Project README](https://github.com/tolo/trellis/blob/main/README.md): SDK overview, package map, and the `trellis` CLI.
- [Framework integration guide](https://github.com/tolo/trellis/blob/main/docs/guides/framework-integration.md): Shelf middleware, Dart Frog and Relic handlers, HTMX fragments and OOB swaps, template testing, error handling, AOT deployment notes.
- [API reference](https://pub.dev/documentation/trellis/latest/): Generated Dart API docs for the `trellis` package.

## Optional

- [Theme usage guide](https://github.com/tolo/trellis/blob/main/docs/guides/theme-usage.md): Using themes in a Trellis site.
- [Theme authoring guide](https://github.com/tolo/trellis/blob/main/docs/guides/theme-authoring.md): Building a reusable theme.
- [Standard params reference](https://github.com/tolo/trellis/blob/main/docs/reference/standard-params.md): Standard template/context parameters.
- [pub.dev package](https://pub.dev/packages/trellis): Install, changelog, scores.
